intent.outcome: cargo test runs deterministically under parallel execution — concurrent cargo test --test X invocations against the same workspace no longer intermittently fail on shared-binary spawn or shared ~/.agents state, so CI and local runs are flake-free by default.

problem.description: Three backlog items (B-70, B-73, B-77) describe the same root cause: when two cargo test --test X invocations run concurrently against the same workspace (e.g. suite_install + suite_milestone), ~13/30 runs produce intermittent spawn-failure or mp-command-failure panics. The failures cluster in two layers. Layer 1 (recursive try_build_workspace under ac_verify) is already FIXED (no occurrences remain in src). Layer 2 persists: concurrent test processes spawn target/debug/mp (and raul) and race on the shared binary build + shared ~/.agents/master-plan/ install-dir state (env.sh, stowed binaries). run_with_retry (common/mod.rs:16) mitigates but does not eliminate the flake. Affected surfaces include suite_install::uninstall_removes_env_sh, milestone_bulk::bulk_dry_run_does_not_persist, install_deploy::uninstall_removes_raul_binary, and milestone_priority::set_priority_all_valid_values — all of which pass in isolation. Note: B-77 sub-item 3 (install_skills_v2 stale TOML stubs) was already fixed and is out of scope.

in_scope: B-70/B-73/B-77 (consolidated): eliminate the parallel-cargo-test spawn + shared-state race
Isolate per-test ~/.agents/master-plan/ state so concurrent test processes do not share install-dir state
Pin a deterministic test-binary story so concurrent spawns do not race on target/debug/mp build/copy
out_of_scope: The install_skills_v2 stale-TOML-stub sub-item (B-77 sub-3) — already fixed
Rewriting the test framework wholesale — only the concurrency/isolation surfaces

acceptance_criteria.description: AC-01: cargo test -p mp -p raul under default threading passes N/N consecutive runs (N>=5) with zero intermittent spawn-failure or mp-command-failure panics, including the previously-flaky suite_install/milestone_bulk/install_deploy/milestone_priority tests.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do cargo test -p mp -p raul || exit 1; done; echo ok

acceptance_criteria.description: AC-02: concurrent test processes do not share ~/.agents/master-plan/ install-dir state — each test (or test process) gets isolated state (per-test tempdir MP_HOME or equivalent), so an uninstall/stow in one process cannot race another.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Two regression tests: (1) parallel_tests_use_isolated_agents_state fires N=8 parallel mp install --harness opencode + N=8 parallel uninstall --purge with per-thread TempDirs, verifies each thread's toolkit artifacts (bin/mp, bin/raul, env.sh) exist after install and are gone after uninstall with no cross-process contamination. (2) parallel_tests_isolate_all_eight_harnesses fires N=8 parallel mp install --harness both and asserts each of the 8 MP_<HARNESS>_SKILL_DIR paths produced its own SKILL.md under its own tempdir. Pre-M132 both would have either leaked into ~/.agents/<h>/skills/master-planner on the dev machine or raced on the shared target/debug/mp spawn. 5x consecutive cargo test -p mp -p raul all green (1278/1278).

acceptance_criteria.description: AC-03: Closure — the full suite is green and the plan validates clean.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M132 closed. All 3 ACs passed (AC-01 5x consecutive runs green, AC-02 parallel_tests_use_isolated_agents_state regression test passes, AC-03 mp validate clean + all backlog items resolved). Strategy: (a) installed stable-mp-bin snapshot in tests/common/mod.rs:mp_bin() — copies CARGO_BIN_EXE_mp once into a per-process scratch dir so cargo's transient unlink of target/debug/mp can't race our spawns; (b) closed 8 install/uninstall harness-isolation gaps across install_env_snippet, install_deploy, install_registry, install_source, workflow_gates, p7_optional_batch, p6_install_bootstrap; (c) added regression test parallel_tests_use_isolated_agents_state.rs that fires N=8 parallel install+uninstall --purge with per-thread TempDirs. B-70, B-73, B-77 resolved into this milestone.

design_decisions.choice: Defer the concrete approach (single pre-built test binary, full per-test tempdir isolation, or adopting nextest as canonical runner) to decompose.
design_decisions.rationale: Three viable strategies with different blast radius; the spec pins the deterministic-outcome contract, decompose picks the lowest-risk implementation.

design_decisions.choice: AC-01 uses a 5x consecutive-run loop rather than --test-threads=1.
design_decisions.rationale: --test-threads=1 is the current workaround, not the contract; the contract is that default parallel execution is deterministic.

work_packages.name: Install-dir state isolation
work_packages.goal: Each test process gets isolated ~/.agents/master-plan/ state (per-test tempdir MP_HOME), so an uninstall/stow in one process cannot race another. On completion resolve the shared-state half of B-70/B-73/B-77.

work_packages.name: Deterministic test-binary spawn
work_packages.goal: Eliminate the target/debug/mp spawn race at its root (concurrent cargo test processes racing on the workspace package cache / CARGO_BIN_EXE_mp) rather than retry-masking it via run_with_retry. On completion resolve the spawn-race half of B-70/B-73/B-77.

steps.action: Audit every test that touches the shared ~/.agents/master-plan/ install dir (suite_install, install_deploy, install_env_snippet, install_registry, install_source, raul_spec_*). Ensure each uses an isolated MP_HOME tempdir so no two concurrent processes share install-dir state. The TestEnv helper (common/mod.rs:56) already sets MP_HOME=repo_root for some paths — confirm install tests route stows/uninstalls through a per-test tempdir, not the real home.
steps.done_when: no test reads/writes the real ~/.agents/master-plan/; concurrent processes cannot collide on install-dir state

steps.action: Address the root cause of the target/debug/mp spawn race (run_with_retry at common/mod.rs:16 documents it: concurrent cargo test processes race on the workspace package cache and momentarily clobber CARGO_BIN_EXE_mp). Pick the lowest-risk fix during execution: either (a) pre-build the test binary once into a stable path and point tests at it, (b) adopt nextest as the canonical parallel runner with process isolation, or (c) a per-test copy of the binary. The goal is determinism, not retry-masking.

steps.done_when: 5x consecutive cargo test -p mp -p raul under default threading all green, zero intermittent spawn failures
